Mrs. Fisher: Welcome back. You look like shit.
You: Thanks…
Mrs. Fisher: Oh, I guess you haven’t gone completely crazy, you still have the mental capability to use sarcasm. 
You: Is that your opinion as an expert on unregulated oceanic drugs?
#mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: You are goddamn right.
You: See you later, I’m going home.
